Alternate_Incline_Dumbbell_Curl: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging and palms facing forward.
Curl one dumbbell towards your shoulder without moving the elbow and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other arm. The incline stretches the biceps more.
Barbell_Curls_Lying_Against_An_Incline: Lie on your back on an incline bench with a barbell in your hands and your arms hanging behind your torso.
Bend your elbows to raise the bar without moving your arms.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Cable_Preacher_Curl: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and rest your arms on the pad, holding the bar.
Curl the bar up by bending your elbows.
Lower with control until your arms are almost straight.
Close-Grip_EZ_Bar_Curl: Stand and grab the EZ bar on the inner grips, hands close together.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Close-Grip_Standing_Barbell_Curl: Stand and grab the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands closer than shoulder width.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Concentration_Curls: Sit on a bench with your legs apart and rest the back of your arm against your inner thigh, dumbbell in hand.
Curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder without moving your arm.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Cross_Body_Hammer_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl one dumbbell across the front of your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Drag_Curl: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and your palms facing forward.
Raise the bar close to your body, pulling your elbows back as if dragging it up your torso.
Dumbbell_Alternate_Bicep_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up, turning the palm upwards, with the elbow at your side.
Dumbbell_Prone_Incline_Curl: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell hanging in each hand.
Curl the dumbbells by bending your elbows without moving them.
High_Cable_Curls: Stand between two high pulleys with a handle in each hand and your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows, bringing your hands towards your head as if flexing your biceps.
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging.
Curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders without bringing your elbows forward.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Incline_Hammer_Curls: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl the dumbbells without turning your wrists.
Incline_Inner_Biceps_Curl: Sit on an incline bench with the dumbbells hanging and your arms angled slightly outwards.
Curl the dumbbells keeping your elbows out.
Lying_Cable_Curl: Lie on your back on the floor facing a low pulley, holding the bar with your arms by your body.
Bend your elbows, bringing the bar towards your chest.
Lying_Close-Grip_Bar_Curl_On_High_Pulley: Lie on your back on a bench with your head towards a high pulley and grab the bar with your arms vertical.
Bend your elbows, bringing the bar towards your forehead without moving your arms.
Lying_High_Bench_Barbell_Curl: Lie face down on a high bench with your arms hanging over the end, holding the bar.
Curl the bar up by bending your elbows.
Lying_Supine_Dumbbell_Curl: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Machine_Bicep_Curl: Sit in the machine with your arms on the pad.
Curl the handles up by bending your elbows.
Machine_Preacher_Curls: Sit in the preacher curl machine with your arms supported.
Curl the handles up by bending your elbows.
Lower with control until your arms are almost straight.
One_Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl: Rest one arm on a preacher bench with the dumbbell in your hand.
Curl it up by bending your elbow.
Lower with control until almost straight and switch sides.
Overhead_Cable_Curl: Stand side-on to a high pulley with the handle in your hand and your arm at shoulder height.
Bend your elbow, bringing your hand towards your head.
Return with control and switch sides.
Preacher_Curl: Sit at the preacher bench with your arms on the pad and the bar in your hands.
Curl the bar up by bending your elbows.
Lower with control until almost straight, without bouncing at the bottom.
Preacher_Hammer_Dumbbell_Curl: Rest your arms on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl the dumbbells without turning your wrists.
Reverse_Barbell_Curl: Stand and grab the bar with your palms facing down, shoulder-width apart.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Lower with control. It works the forearms a lot.
Reverse_Barbell_Preacher_Curls: Rest your arms on a preacher bench and grab the EZ bar with your palms facing down.
Curl it up by bending your elbows.
Reverse_Cable_Curl: Stand facing a low pulley and grab the bar with your palms facing down.
With your elbows at your sides, curl it towards your shoulders.
Seated_Close-Grip_Concentration_Barbell_: Sit on a bench, lean forward and rest your elbows against your inner thighs, holding a barbell.
Curl the bar towards your chest.
Seated_Dumbbell_Curl: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up, turning your palms upwards.
Seated_Dumbbell_Inner_Biceps_Curl: Sit with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms angled slightly outwards.
Curl the dumbbells keeping your elbows out.
Spider_Curl: Lie face down on the vertical side of a preacher bench, arms hanging, holding the EZ bar.
Curl the bar up by bending your elbows.
Standing_Concentration_Curl: Stand, lean your torso forward and let the arm with the dumbbell hang.
Curl it towards your shoulder without moving your arm.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Standing_Dumbbell_Reverse_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Curl the dumbbells with your elbows at your sides.
Standing_Inner-Biceps_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms angled slightly outwards.
Curl the dumbbells keeping your elbows out.
Standing_One-Arm_Cable_Curl: Stand facing a low pulley with a handle in one hand.
Curl the handle towards your shoulder with your elbow at your side.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Curl_Over_Incl: Stand behind an incline bench and rest your arm over the backrest, dumbbell in hand.
Curl it up by bending your elbow.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Two-Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl: Rest your arms on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the dumbbells by bending your elbows.
Wide-Grip_Standing_Barbell_Curl: Stand and grab the bar with your palms facing forward and your hands wider than your shoulders.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar up.
Zottman_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up and, at the top, turn your palms down.
Lower slowly like that, then turn your palms back up at the bottom.
Zottman_Preacher_Curl: Rest your arms on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Curl the dumbbells up and, at the top, turn your palms down.
Lower slowly and turn your palms back again.
Bench_Press_-_Powerlifting: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, squeeze your shoulder blades together, arch your back slightly and plant your feet firmly.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control to your lower chest.
Press hard until your arms are straight without lifting your glutes. Use a spotter.
Board_Press: Lie on the bench and have someone place a few boards on your chest.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press until your arms are straight. It trains the top part of the press.
Body-Up: Push through your hands, straightening your elbows until you are on your palms, without moving your feet.
Lower back to your forearms with control.
Cable_Incline_Triceps_Extension: Lie on an incline bench with your back to a low pulley, holding the bar overhead with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms without moving your elbows.
Cable_Lying_Triceps_Extension: Lie on a bench with your head towards a low pulley and grab the bar with your arms vertical.
Bend your elbows, bringing the bar towards your forehead, then straighten them again.
Cable_One_Arm_Tricep_Extension: Stand facing a high pulley, grab the handle with one hand and keep your elbow at your side.
Straighten your arm downwards without moving your elbow.
Return with control and switch sides.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension: With your back to a pulley, hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms forwards and upwards.
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press: Lie on the bench and grab the bar at shoulder width or slightly narrower.
Lower it to your lower chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
Close-Grip_Dumbbell_Press: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells together over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them together to your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
Close-Grip_EZ-Bar_Press: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar on the inner grips.
Lower it to your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
Close-Grip_Push-Up_off_of_a_Dumbbell: Get into a push-up position with your hands on a dumbbell lying on its side.
Lower with your elbows close to your body until your chest brushes the dumbbell.
Push until your arms are straight.
Decline_Close-Grip_Bench_To_Skull_Crushe: Lie on a decline bench with a close grip.
Lower the bar to your chest and press; on the next rep, bend only your elbows to bring it to your forehead.
Decline_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms vertical.
Bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbells beside your head.
Decline_EZ_Bar_Triceps_Extension: Lie on a decline bench with the EZ bar and your arms vertical.
Bend your elbows, bringing the bar towards your forehead.
Dip_Machine: Sit in the dip machine and grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Dumbbell_Floor_Press: Lie on your back on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and your elbows resting on the floor.
Press until your arms are straight.
Lower until your elbows touch the floor.
Dumbbell_One-Arm_Triceps_Extension: Sitting or standing, hold a dumbbell overhead with one hand.
Bend your elbow, lowering it behind your head.
Straighten your arm to return and switch sides.
Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension_-Pronated_Grip: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms vertical and palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbells towards your head.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher: Lie on a bench with the EZ bar over your chest and your arms straight.
Bend your elbows, lowering the bar towards your forehead without moving your arms.
Floor_Press: Lie on your back on the floor inside the rack with the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar until your elbows touch the floor.
Press until your arms are straight.
Floor_Press_with_Chains: Lie on the floor with chains hanging from the ends of the bar.
Lower the bar until your elbows touch the floor.
Press until your arms are straight: the load increases as you go up.
Incline_Barbell_Triceps_Extension: Lie on an incline bench with the bar overhead and your arms straight.
Bend your elbows, lowering the bar behind your head.
Incline_Push-Up_Close-Grip: Place your hands close together on a bench, body straight.
Lower with your elbows close to your body.
Push until your arms are straight.
JM_Press: Lie on the bench with a close grip.
Lower the bar towards your upper chest by bending your elbows, which travel forward towards your feet.
Press until your arms are straight. A mix of close-grip press and extension: use a light weight.
Kettlebell_Overhead_Triceps_Extension: Hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands overhead.
Bend your elbows, lowering it behind your head.
Kneeling_Cable_Triceps_Extension: Kneel with your back to a high pulley, holding the rope behind your head.
Low_Cable_Triceps_Extension: With your back to a low pulley, hold the rope or bar behind your head.
Lying_Close-Grip_Barbell_Triceps_Extensi: Lie on a bench with the bar over your chest and a close grip.
Bend your elbows, taking the bar behind your head.
Lying_Close-Grip_Barbell_Triceps_Press_T: Lie on a bench with the EZ bar over your chest and a close grip.
Lower the bar towards your chin by bending your elbows.
Press until your arms are straight.
Lying_Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms vertical.
Bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbells beside your ears.
Machine_Triceps_Extension: Sit in the machine with your arms on the pad.
Straighten your arms, pushing the handles.
One_Arm_Floor_Press: Lie on the floor holding a barbell by the middle with one hand.
Lower it until your elbow touches the floor.
Press until your arm is straight and switch sides. Control the balance of the bar.
One_Arm_Pronated_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand, arm vertical and palm facing your feet.
Bend your elbow, lowering the dumbbell towards the opposite side of your chest.
Straighten your arm to return and switch sides.
One_Arm_Supinated_Dumbbell_Triceps_Exten: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand, arm vertical and palm facing your head.
Bend your elbow, lowering the dumbbell towards your shoulder.
Straighten your arm to return and switch sides.
Pin_Presses: Lie on a bench inside the rack with the bar resting on the safety pins a few centimetres above your chest.
Press the bar off the pins until your arms are straight.
Set it back down on the pins.
Reverse_Band_Bench_Press: Hang bands from the top of the rack and hook them to the bar; they will help you at the bottom.
Press hard until your arms are straight. For advanced lifters.
Reverse_Grip_Triceps_Pushdown: Grab the high pulley bar with your palms facing up.
Straighten your arms downwards with your elbows at your sides.
Reverse_Triceps_Bench_Press: Lie on the bench and grab the bar with your palms facing you.
Lower it to your lower chest with your elbows tucked.
Press until your arms are straight. Use a light weight and a spotter.
Seated_Bent-Over_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Tricep: Sitting on the edge of a bench, lean forward with the dumbbell in one hand and your upper arm against your body.
Straighten your elbow, taking the dumbbell backwards.
Return with control and switch sides.
Seated_Bent-Over_Two-Arm_Dumbbell_Tricep: Sitting on the edge of a bench, lean forward with a dumbbell in each hand.
Straighten your elbows, taking the dumbbells backwards.
Seated_Triceps_Press: Sitting, hold a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Bend your elbows, lowering it behind your head.
Smith_Machine_Close-Grip_Bench_Press: Place a bench under the Smith machine bar and take a close grip.
Lower it to your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
Speed_Band_Overhead_Triceps: With your back to a band's anchor point, hold it behind your head with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms quickly forwards and upwards.
Return with control and repeat at a steady pace.
Standing_Bent-Over_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Tric: Lean forward with one hand on a bench and the dumbbell in the other, upper arm against your body.
Straighten your elbow, taking the dumbbell backwards.
Return with control and switch sides.
Standing_Bent-Over_Two-Arm_Dumbbell_Tric: Stand and lean your torso forward with a dumbbell in each hand and your upper arms against your body.
Straighten your elbows, taking the dumbbells backwards.
Standing_Low-Pulley_One-Arm_Triceps_Exte: With your back to a low pulley, hold the handle behind your head with one hand.
Return with control and switch sides.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens: Standing, hold a dumbbell overhead with one hand.
Bend your elbow, lowering it behind your head.
Straighten your arm to return and switch sides.
Standing_Overhead_Barbell_Triceps_Extens: Standing, hold a barbell or EZ bar overhead with a close grip.
Bend your elbows, lowering it behind your head.
Standing_Towel_Triceps_Extension: Standing, hold a towel behind your head with one hand and the other end with the other hand at your lower back.
Straighten the top arm while the other hand resists by pulling down.
Return with control and switch sides.
Tate_Press: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight and palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows outwards, lowering the dumbbells until they touch over your chest.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback: Rest one knee and one hand on a bench, with the dumbbell in the other hand and your upper arm against your body, parallel to the floor.
Straighten your elbow, taking the dumbbell backwards.
Return with control and switch sides.
Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope: With your back to a low pulley, hold the rope behind your head.
Straighten your arms upwards, spreading your hands slightly at the end.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment: Attach the rope to the high pulley and grab it with your elbows at your sides.
Straighten your arms downwards, pulling the rope ends apart at the end.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_V-Bar_Attachment: Attach the V-bar to the high pulley and grab it with your elbows at your sides.
Bottoms-Up_Clean_From_The_Hang_Position: Hold a kettlebell hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, bring it up to shoulder height with the bell facing up, squeezing the handle hard.
Lower it with control. It demands a strong grip.
Cable_Wrist_Curl: Sit facing a low pulley with your forearms on your thighs and the bar in your hands, palms up.
Curl your wrists, raising the bar.
Dumbbell_Lying_Pronation: Lie down with your forearm supported, holding a light dumbbell by one end, palm facing up.
Rotate your wrist until your palm faces down.
Return with control and switch sides.
Dumbbell_Lying_Supination: Lie down with your forearm supported, holding a light dumbbell by one end, palm facing down.
Rotate your wrist until your palm faces up.
Return with control and switch sides.
Finger_Curls: Sitting, with your forearms on your thighs and the bar in your hands, palms up.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Close your fingers to roll it back up and curl your wrists.
Palms-Down_Dumbbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Be: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms on it and your hands over the edge, a dumbbell in each, palms down.
Raise the backs of your hands by bending your wrists upwards.
Palms-Down_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms on it and the bar in your hands, palms down.
Raise the bar by bending your wrists upwards.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms on it and the bar in your hands, palms up.
Raise the bar by curling your wrists.
Palms-Up_Dumbbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Benc: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms on it and a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Raise the dumbbells by curling your wrists.
Seated_Dumbbell_Palms-Down_Wrist_Curl: Sitting, with your forearms on your thighs and a dumbbell in each hand, palms down.
Raise the backs of your hands by bending your wrists.
Seated_Dumbbell_Palms-Up_Wrist_Curl: Sitting, with your forearms on your thighs and a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Raise the dumbbells by curling your wrists.
Seated_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Palms-Down_Wrist: Sitting, with one forearm on your thigh and the dumbbell in your hand, palm down.
Raise the back of your hand by bending your wrist.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Seated_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Palms-Up_Wrist_C: Sitting, with one forearm on your thigh and the dumbbell in your hand, palm up.
Raise the dumbbell by curling your wrist.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Seated_Palm-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl: Sitting, with your forearms on your thighs and the bar in your hands, palms up.
Raise the bar by curling your wrists.
Seated_Palms-Down_Barbell_Wrist_Curl: Sitting, with your forearms on your thighs and the bar in your hands, palms down.
Raise the bar by bending your wrists upwards.
Seated_Two-Arm_Palms-Up_Low-Pulley_Wrist: Sit facing a low pulley with your forearms on your thighs and the bar in your hands, palms up.
Raise the bar by curling your wrists.
Standing_Palms-Up_Barbell_Behind_The_Bac: Standing, hold the bar behind your thighs with your palms facing back.
Curl your wrists, raising the bar.
Wrist_Rotations_with_Straight_Bar: Standing, hold a bar in front of your body with your arms straight.
Rotate your wrists alternately, as if winding up a rope.
Keep the rhythm for the set time.
